newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR MAY 2-4.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR MAY 2-4.

text.p: English and Scottish league
soccer fixtures (all Saturday, May 3 unless stated):
English premier league - Arsenal v Newcastle, Chelsea v
Leeds, Coventry v Derby, Leicester v Manchester United,
Liverpool v Tottenham, Middlesbrough v Aston Villa, Nottingham
Forest v Wimbledon, Southampton v Blackburn, Sunderland v
Everton, West Ham v Sheffield Wednesday.
Division one - (all May 4) Bradford v Queens Park Rangers,
Charlton v Sheffield United, Crystal Palace v Port Vale, Grimsby
v Southend, Huddersfield v Swindon, Ipswich v Birmingham,
Manchester City v Reading, Oldham v Norwich, Oxford v Barnsley,
Stoke v West Bromwich, Tranmere v Bolton, Wolverhampton v
Portsmouth.
Division two - Brentford v Peterborough, Bristol Rovers v
Rotherham, Burnley v Watford, Bury v Millwall, Chesterfield v
Notts County, Gillingham v Shrewsbury, Luton v Stockport,
Plymouth v Bournemouth, Preston v Walsall, Wrexham v Blackpool,
Wycombe v Bristol City, York v Crewe.
Division three - Barnet v Colchester, Cambridge United v
Fulham, Carlisle v Exeter, Chester v Leyton Orient, Darlington v
Cardiff, Doncaster v Torquay, Hereford v Brighton, Hull v
Scarborough, Lincoln v Rochdale, Northampton v Scunthorpe,
Swansea v Hartlepool, Wigan v Mansfield.
Scottish premier - Aberdeen v Raith, Dundee United v Hearts,
Dunfermline v Kilmarnock, Hibernian v Celtic (May 4)
Division one - East Fife v Airdrieonians, Greenock Morton v
Dundee, Partick v Falkirk, St Johnstone v St Mirren, Stirling v
Clydebank.
Division two - Ayr v Brechin, Clyde v Hamilton, Dumbarton v
Queen of the South, Livingston v Stranraer, Stenhousemuir v
Berwick.
Division three - Arbroath v Alloa, Inverness C.Thistle v
Forfar, Montrose v Cowdenbeath, Queen's Park v Ross County.
Playing Friday, May 2: Albion v East Stirling.
